text: Done in agent-parser c127402 and agent-watcher 1f79e50, unreleased: consumers pin a pseudo-version, because both repositories require explicit authorization for releases. The Rust counterparts use rusqlite, a different dependency, so they did not change. The binary shrank rather than grew: a CGO_ENABLED=0 probe through agent-watcher went from 14.8 MB to 11.1 MB. Query time is unchanged (about 15 ms for 200 reconstructions on both drivers). A CGO_ENABLED=0 build read a real OpenCode 1.19.5 database, and tests cover reads beside a WAL writer, rejected writes and the in-memory DSN. linux/arm64 and darwin/arm64 cross-compile.
